name: PlainMoney - Personal Finance
subtitle: No accounts, no bank linking
shortDescription: New in 1.1: ask money questions with on-device AI that runs entirely on your phone. Off by default, and nothing you type leaves your device.
longDescription:
Plain-language, offline personal finance help for everyday money decisions — no accounts, no bank-linking, and nothing about you ever leaves your phone.

### What It Does
- See exactly where you stand today: what's left until payday, what bills are due, and what you've spent this cycle.
- Track spending and bills, with an early heads-up before a bill is due or you're off pace.
- Decode a real paycheck: gross pay, federal tax, Social Security, Medicare, and deductions, broken down line by line.
- Estimate your federal income tax for the year.
- Run a 50/30/20 budget split on your real take-home pay.
- Plan a debt's payoff, or see the real cost of paying only the minimum.
- Project how savings could grow over time across index funds, bonds, T-Bills, or your own investments — using real historical return data (the NYU Stern/Damodaran dataset), never made-up numbers.
- Set and track a savings goal.

SAFETY NET — always free
A dedicated Safety tab covers scam patterns, coercive financial control and elder-exploitation warning signs, benefits guidance, and disaster recovery. Free forever, for everyone — Safety content never has a Pro paywall placed in front of it.

### How It Works
Every screen explains how something works. It never tells you what to buy, sell, or borrow. Every tool and guide ends with a plain reminder: this is education, not financial advice.
whatsNew: PlainMoney now shows ads in its free content (Google AdMob; you will see a consent prompt where required). A one-time "Remove Ads" purchase removes them. Restore Purchases is in Settings. Existing purchases are unchanged.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
